exact: cellular response to UV light stimulus
cellular response to UV radiation stimulus
cellular response to ultraviolet light stimulus
cellular response to ultraviolet radiation stimulus

definition: Any process that results in a change in state or activity of a cell (in terms of movement, secretion, enzyme production, gene expression, etc.) as a result of an ultraviolet radiation (UV light) stimulus. Ultraviolet radiation is electromagnetic radiation with a wavelength in the range of 10 to 380 nanometers.
label: cellular response to UV
